name: Nexa Shop — Store, Cart, Checkout & Orders
author: NexaCMS
description: Full WooCommerce-style store: catalog with categories/search/sort, product pages, coupons, cart, shipping zones with flat/weight-based/free/pickup rates per country, checkout (COD, bank transfer, PayPal, Stripe), orders with stock control, customer My Account with downloads — plus a setup wizard that creates the store pages and collects your store details.
